title: Sanskrit Bible (New Testament, Satyavedah), IAST romanization, one verse per line
period: modern Sanskrit (19th-century Calcutta NT tradition, 2018 digital edition by SanskritBible.in)
notes: License: 'cc-by-sa' is stated for translation id 'sanias' in the eBible corpus licence table https://github.com/BibleNLP/ebible/blob/2bde52b4c2cfd7056cf4ed07c48969647df79744/metadata/licences.tsv (taken from eBible.org's copyright page, https://ebible.org/sanias/copr.htm). The url pins a fixed commit, so the bytes do not change. 1,170,216 bytes; eBible corpus format: one verse per line aligned to a fixed versification (empty lines for verses the translation lacks; '<range>' marks merged verses, a few letters each). vs/refcorpus.normalize(..., 'sanskrit') gives 918,815 characters. Copyright SanskritBible.in 2018, CC BY-SA 4.0. IAST chosen over the Devanagari file of the same text because the generic normalization drops Devanagari vowel signs; IAST diacritics fold to plain a-z (long/short vowels and retroflexes merge).
